$comment: Per-suite wall-clock durations (ms) for the general-server vitest lane, used by scripts/general-server-shard.mjs to balance suites across the PR shard matrix. Regenerated 2026-09-18 from actions run 35289958945 (merge_group for PR #722 on fold/tea-patches-v2026.722.0, commit 20f5e6c51906), a fully green run whose five 'General tests (server (N/5))' job logs (105430627989 / 105430628002 / 105430628055 / 105430627985 / 105430628038) together cover all 749 selected suites. Each suite's cost is the wall-clock delta between its '✓ <path>' completion timestamp and the previous suite's (or the Vitest RUN line for the first suite) in the 'Run grouped general test suites' logs, which captures import/collection, not just vitest-reported test time. The previous 2026-09-08 sample covered only 534 suites, so 213 of today's 749 suites were absent from the manifest and took the median fallback weight; that drift is what let shard 3/5 ride the 20-minute job cap on #722. Entries for suites this run did not cover are retained. NOTE: server/src/__tests__/chat-channels.integration.test.ts is recorded at 900000ms rather than its measured 376797ms. run-vitest-stable-shard.test.mjs requires the chat cohort to occupy exactly one shard with no other suites, and the LPT partition only keeps it alone when its weight is at least the other four shards' balanced load (~893s here). Reserving that shard bounds the chat cohort's high run-to-run variance (377s-645s observed) instead of letting it stretch a second shard past the cap.
